# index

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/index"
```

Package index writes the README linking every page the other generators wrote.

<a name="Emit"></a>
## func [Emit](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/docgen/blob/main/index/index.go#L16>)

```go
func Emit(dir string, pages, examples []spec.GeneratedFile) (spec.GeneratedFile, error)
```

Emit writes a README.md to dir linking to the generated reference and example pages. Sections with no files are omitted. Links are computed from each GeneratedFile.Path, so the filename rule lives in exactly one place.
